en: Color photo postcard showing a busy bathing resort with jetties and many swimmers on a large salt lake, with red‑tiled village houses and a church tower on a green hillside in the background. The reverse has handwritten Romanian text, a Romanian postage stamp (40 bani, POSTA ROMANA, flower), a București postmark dated 1976, and printed credits mentioning Ocna Sibiului.
